integrity.euler_basis: Later full-text complete-quadrics work explicitly identifies the torus-fixed-point count kappa(n) with the Euler characteristic and gives its closed form.
integrity.object_basis: The archival source constructs the space of complete quadrics as an iterated blowup along symmetric rank loci.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival complete-quadrics source is algebraic geometry; its journal classification lists 14C20 first.
integrity.valuation_basis: The exact two-adic formula follows from a proved Lucas-sequence valuation lemma plus Legendre's identity.

scientific_limitations: The result determines only the two-adic valuation of the Euler characteristic, not its odd part.
General valuation theorems for Lucas or Lehmer sequences may subsume the auxiliary recurrence lemma in different notation.
No statement is made about odd-prime valuations.
title: Exact dyadic valuation of complete-quadrics Euler characteristics
